INSERT INTO gsa_publication(gsa_record_key,pmid,doi,title,pub_year,journal_title,source_url,grants_json,cncb_banks_json, raw_payload,gsa_raw_payload,gsa_source_hash,source_hash,gsa_accessions,bioproject_accession,is_primary,is_related,gsa_enrichment_status) VALUES (#{r.recordKey},#{r.pmid},#{r.doi},#{r.title},#{r.pubYear},#{r.journalTitle},#{r.sourceUrl},#{r.grantsJson},#{r.cncbBanksJson}, #{r.rawPayload},#{r.rawPayload},#{r.sourceHash},#{r.sourceHash},#{r.accessions},#{r.bioprojectAccession},#{r.primary},#{r.related},'PENDING')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_primary=GREATEST(is_primary,VALUES(is_primary)),is_related=GREATEST(is_related,VALUES(is_related)), gsa_record_key=COALESCE(gsa_record_key,VALUES(gsa_record_key)), relation_status=CASE WHEN NOT(gsa_source_hash<=>VALUES(gsa_source_hash)) THEN 'PENDING' ELSE relation_status END, gsa_enrichment_status=CASE WHEN NOT(gsa_source_hash<=>VALUES(gsa_source_hash)) THEN 'PENDING' ELSE gsa_enrichment_status END, pmid=COALESCE(pmid,VALUES(pmid)),doi=COALESCE(VALUES(doi),doi), title=CASE WHEN NOT(gsa_source_hash<=>VALUES(gsa_source_hash)) THEN VALUES(title) ELSE title END, pub_year=COALESCE(VALUES(pub_year),pub_year),journal_title=COALESCE(NULLIF(VALUES(journal_title),''),journal_title), cncb_banks_json=VALUES(cncb_banks_json),gsa_accessions=VALUES(gsa_accessions),bioproject_accession=VALUES(bioproject_accession), gsa_raw_payload=CASE WHEN NOT(gsa_source_hash<=>VALUES(gsa_source_hash)) THEN VALUES(gsa_raw_payload) ELSE gsa_raw_payload END, gsa_source_hash=VALUES(gsa_source_hash)
mapper.update: UPDATE gsa_publication SET relation_status=CASE id WHEN #{r.id} THEN CASE WHEN #{r.sourceHash} IS NOT NULL AND NOT(source_hash<=>#{r.sourceHash}) THEN 'PENDING' ELSE relation_status END ELSE relation_status END, pmid=CASE id WHEN #{r.id} THEN COALESCE(#{r.pmid},pmid) ELSE pmid END, doi=CASE id WHEN #{r.id} THEN COALESCE(#{r.doi},doi) ELSE doi END, title=CASE id WHEN #{r.id} THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(#{r.title},''),title) ELSE title END, pub_year=CASE id WHEN #{r.id} THEN COALESCE(#{r.pubYear},pub_year) ELSE pub_year END, journal_title=CASE id WHEN #{r.id} THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(#{r.journalTitle},''),journal_title) ELSE journal_title END, authors_json=CASE id WHEN #{r.id} THEN #{r.authorsJson} ELSE authors_json END, affiliation_info=CASE id WHEN #{r.id} THEN #{r.affiliationInfo} ELSE affiliation_info END, grants_json=CASE id WHEN #{r.id} THEN #{r.grantsJson} ELSE grants_json END, cncb_banks_json=CASE id WHEN #{r.id} THEN #{r.cncbBanksJson} ELSE cncb_banks_json END, mesh_headings_json=CASE id WHEN #{r.id} THEN #{r.meshHeadingsJson} ELSE mesh_headings_json END, keyword_list=CASE id WHEN #{r.id} THEN #{r.keywordList} ELSE keyword_list END, abstract_text=CASE id WHEN #{r.id} THEN #{r.abstractText} ELSE abstract_text END, raw_payload=CASE id WHEN #{r.id} THEN COALESCE(#{r.rawPayload},raw_payload) ELSE raw_payload END, gsa_enrichment_status=CASE id WHEN #{r.id} THEN #{r.status} ELSE gsa_enrichment_status END, gsa_enrichment_error=CASE id WHEN #{r.id} THEN #{r.error} ELSE gsa_enrichment_error END, source_hash=CASE id WHEN #{r.id} THEN COALESCE(#{r.sourceHash},source_hash) ELSE source_hash END, gsa_enrichment_attempts=gsa_enrichment_attempts+1,gsa_metadata_checked_at=NOW() WHERE id IN #{r.id}
